Hair Transplant in Turkey vs the UK: Hidden Costs Checked Line by Line

Comparing a Turkish package with a UK clinic quote is only fair when both list the same items. This checklist walks through the lines UK patients most often find missing.

What Turkish packages usually bundle

  • Airport transfers between the hotel and the clinic
  • Hotel nights for the length of the treatment stay
  • Blood tests before the procedure and aftercare products
  • A first hair wash at the clinic after the procedure

Lines often missing from UK quotes

Consultation fees, prescribed medication and follow-up appointments may be charged separately, so ask each clinic for an itemised written quote.

Patients should also ask who performs each step of the procedure and how follow-up will be handled once they are back home.

Flights, travel insurance and time off work are personal costs that sit outside both quotes and belong in your own budget.
